patchdist_score — SPC anomaly_patch op

• Datenarten: image2d × table → table

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.patchdist_score(image, model, smooth=4.0) (die Implementierung direkt: import anomaly_patch; anomaly_patch.patchdist_score(image, model, smooth=4.0); aus dem Register: opsspc.get("patchdist_score"))

• GPU: nein (nur CPU-Referenzimplementierung)

Verwendung

Ein Bild gegen die Normalverteilung je Position bewerten: Anomaliekarte aus der Mahalanobis-Distanz je Patch (table).

> Die ausführliche Beschreibung unten ist der Originaltext — Zusammenfassung und Überschriften sind übersetzt.

model comes from patchdist_fit; image must have the training images' shape. The grid of distances sqrt((x - mu)' P (x - mu)) is interpolated (bilinear, between patch centres) to the image size and smoothed by a Gaussian of smooth px (0 = no smoothing). Returns map (H, W; higher = more anomalous), grid (the raw distances), image_score (the maximum of the smoothed map) and smooth.

Raises ValueError for a model that is not a patchdist_fit result, a different image shape, or a negative / non-finite smooth.
